historical_fci07_bridge_probe.interpretation: The historical bridge is not a valid current-Status-A end-to-end harness and cannot be used as positive or negative scientific evidence.

reason: The Status-A scientific production tree is a typed kernel/runtime and focused process-migration baseline, not a standalone 63-file legacy executable.
The exact Hupsel case activates cultivated crop physics (simple plus detailed WOFOST), fixed irrigation, drainage, numerical heat transport and solute transport in addition to Richards water flow.

Status-A contains admitted process/runtime components for several of these capabilities but no authoritative end-to-end loader/composition/result contract that maps the full legacy Hupsel input set into one 2002-2004 Status-A execution.
No current production solute module exists under src/, so silently dropping SWSOLU=1 would not be an equivalent full-case execution.
Broad public API and wholesale legacy I/O modernization were explicitly outside the Status-A acceptance denominator; therefore this gap does not invalidate Status-A.

verdict_interpretation: Fail-closed evidence verdict, not a negative scientific finding. The former external-asset blocker is resolved and long B0/B1.10 Hupsel reference output is reproduced exactly, but a current Status-A end-to-end Hupsel execution with equivalent activated-process semantics is not yet established.

requirements: No SWAP5 production-source changes merely to obtain a comparison.
Use only already-admitted Status-A process/runtime contracts or a qualification-only adapter/trace harness.
Define process inclusion/exclusion and output mapping before observing Status-A differences.
Do not silently disable legacy Hupsel physics such as crop, irrigation, drainage, heat or solute and still call the result full-case equivalence.
Keep the dedicated WOFOST81 potential-production comparison separate.
Freeze numerical tolerances before observing Status-A-versus-B1.10 differences; no post-hoc widening.
next_permitted_action.alternative: Establish the separately declared semantically comparable B1.10 restart/persisted-state fixture and run the bounded restart comparison, but this does not by itself close the full Hupsel end-to-end gap.
